title: Weave: Efficient and Expressive Oblivious Analytics at Scale
problem: Oblivious analytics systems incur prohibitive computational and memory bandwidth overhead that prevents them from scaling to production-size datasets. Existing approaches trade expressiveness for performance or vice versa, making practical privacy-preserving analytics infeasible at scale.
motivation: Privacy-preserving analytics is critical for sensitive data processing, but oblivious computation techniques are too slow and limited in capability to deploy in real-world systems.
method: Weave optimizes oblivious access patterns through efficient shuffling and batching strategies that amortize overhead costs across multiple queries. The system uses distributed execution and specialized data structures to reduce memory traffic and communication costs. Hardware-aware optimizations and vectorization techniques accelerate core oblivious operations.
key_novelty: A system architecture that achieves both efficiency and expressiveness for privacy-preserving analytics by optimizing oblivious computation overhead through architectural innovations.
contributions: Scalable architecture for oblivious analytics on large datasets
Techniques to reduce oblivious computation overhead through batching and optimization
Demonstration that privacy-preserving analytics can be practical at production scale
limitations: Limitations not discussed with only title available.
